2608.19133.title: Comment-level Topic Drift Analysis in the Reddit Corpus
2608.19133.paper_summary: We present a novel application of embedding-based dynamic topic modeling techniques to detect and quantify topic drift at the comment level in a massive corpus. By leveraging pretrained language models to generate contextualized semantic embeddings for short text, we analyzed 12.7 billion Reddit comments spanning 2006 to 2022. Using unsupervised methods on these embeddings, we identify dynamically evolving topic clusters over time. Our primary contribution is a methodology for analysis of semantic drift and discourse evolution in the embedding space itself. We also demonstrate modifications to existing methods that enable this analysis at scale, and we propose and demonstrate a null model comparison test to filter spurious dynamics. Key findings suggest that politically and socially contentious topics exhibit significant directional drift in embedding space, with inter-topic distances changing systematically over time beyond what the null model can explain, whereas domains such as music and sports remain comparatively stable.
2608.19133.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一種新穎的應用，利用基於嵌入的動態主題建模技術，在龐大的語料庫中檢測和量化評論層級的主題漂移。<lb/>通過利用預訓練的語言模型生成短文本的上下文化語義嵌入，我們分析了從2006年到2022年的127億條Reddit評論。<lb/>使用這些嵌入的無監督方法，我們識別出隨時間動態演變的主題集群。<lb/>我們的主要貢獻是一種在嵌入空間內分析語義漂移和話語演變的方法論。<lb/>我們還展示了對現有方法的修改，使得這種分析能夠在大規模下進行，並提出並展示了一種空模型比較測試，以過濾虛假的動態。<lb/>關鍵發現表明，政治和社會爭議性主題在嵌入空間中顯示出顯著的方向漂移，主題之間的距離隨時間系統性地變化，超出了空模型所能解釋的範圍，而音樂和體育等領域則相對穩定。
